author: ETA PRIME
description:
We turn a budget PC into a dedicated 1440p SteamOS Gaming Machine! In this video, I swap out the Intel Arc GPU for a Radeon RX 7600 to get full SteamOS 3.9 compatibility. We're pairing it with a used Intel Core i5-11600K and DDR4 RAM to keep costs low, but I ran into some serious issues with this AliExpress case. Can this DIY Steam Machine handle Black Myth: Wukong, Starfield, and Spider-Man 2 at 1440p? Let's find out!
